title: Welcome to One & Done
text:
# Welcome, adventurer!

This is a quick tour of how to play. The DM runs the world; you play one hero.

## Your hero's ring

**Click your hero** to open its ring of actions:

- **➜ Move**: click a highlighted square (or drag your token).
- **⚔ Attack**: pick a weapon, then a target in range.
- **🎒 Items**: use or give items from your pack.
- **✋ Act**: your abilities, plus everyday actions like *Investigate*.

## Combat

Combat runs in **phases**: all heroes act in the *player phase*, then the monsters act in the *DM phase*. Each phase you get your **actions** and your **movement**. Watch the timer at the top of the screen.

## Your settings

Click your name (**⚙**) at the top right to change your name, your color, or your hero's name.

> Tip: the Game Feed on the right shows every roll, so nothing is hidden behind the screen.

Good luck. Try hitting a training dummy!
dmNotes: Reveal this at the start so new players know the basics. The dummies can't die, so it's a safe place to try every ability.
